run_evaluator_cli: run the evaluator CLI with --answers and --predictions flags to compute BigCloneBench clone detection scores
read_answers_file: read a ground truth labels text file and return a dictionary mapping code pair tuples to labels
read_predictions_file: read a predictions text file and return a dictionary mapping code pair tuples to predicted labels
calculate_scores_recall_precision_f1: calculate macro recall, precision, and F1 scores by comparing ground truth answers against predictions
review_calculate_scores: review the calculate_scores function to understand how it validates predictions and computes sklearn metrics
